name: repo-hygiene-action
description: GitHub Action that triages issues, validates Conventional Commit pull request titles, and audits PR diffs for debug leftovers and secrets.

scripts.all: npm run build && npm run package
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test lib/test/triageIssue.test.js lib/test/checkPrTitle.test.js lib/test/auditPrDiff.test.js
